# exo_calendar_settings (Data Source)

Look up an existing CalendarSettings object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `enable_preserve_declined_meetings` (String) Maps to the -EnablePreserveDeclinedMeetings parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
